messages.description: Git authentication dialog: title while a Git process the user started waits for an answer
Git authentication dialog: the folder the asking Git process runs in
Git authentication dialog: Git or SSH asks the same question again because the previous answer did not work (attempt is at least 2)
Git authentication dialog: accessible label of the field the answer is typed into
Git authentication dialog: note under a password, token or passphrase field
Git authentication dialog: button that cancels the question, which fails the Git operation
Git authentication dialog: button that passes the typed answer to Git
Git authentication dialog: question after a fetch, pull, push or clone failed to authenticate, whether to run it once more with credentials typed in Lithe
Git authentication dialog: button that runs the failed transfer once more and asks for the credentials in Lithe
Git authentication: notice after Core refused the typed answer, which also cancelled the question
Git authentication: notice after the answer could not be passed to Core

en-US.desktop.gitAuth.title: Git Authentication
en-US.desktop.gitAuth.again: Asked again (attempt {attempt}): the previous answer did not work.
en-US.desktop.gitAuth.secretHint: The answer goes to this Git process only. Lithe does not save it.
en-US.desktop.gitAuth.retryMessage: Git could not authenticate with the remote. Retry once and type the credentials in Lithe instead of using the credential helper?
en-US.desktop.gitAuth.refused: Git did not accept the answer: an answer is at most 8192 bytes and has no line breaks. The question was cancelled.
en-US.desktop.gitAuth.failed: Could not pass the answer to Git: {reason}

zh-CN.desktop.gitAuth.title: Git 身份验证
zh-CN.desktop.gitAuth.again: 第 {attempt} 次询问：上一次的回答没有通过。
zh-CN.desktop.gitAuth.secretHint: 回答只交给这个 Git 进程，Lithe 不会保存。
zh-CN.desktop.gitAuth.retryMessage: Git 没有通过远程仓库的身份验证。要重试一次，并改为在 Lithe 中输入凭据（不使用凭据助手）吗？
zh-CN.desktop.gitAuth.refused: Git 没有接受这个回答：回答最多 8192 字节，且不能包含换行。这个问题已取消。
